Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 0
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misapplied basic physics of rolling resistance by asserting that sand has a lower rolling-resistance coefficient than a smooth hard surface (c_r(sand) ≈ 0.003 vs c_r(smooth) ≈ 0.02). In reality, sand has much higher rolling resistance (often ~0.1–0.3 or higher) than smooth hard surfaces (~0.001–0.015), causing greater deceleration. This led to the incorrect conclusion “B) faster” instead of the correct “A) slower,” and the task was prematurely marked complete without validation.
